mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wms_stock_in WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() AND deleted = 0) AS today_in_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wms_stock_out WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() AND deleted = 0) AS today_out_count, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(final_amount), 0) FROM wms_purchase_order WHERE status IN (1,2) AND deleted = 0) AS in_transit_purchase_amount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sku_id) FROM wms_inventory WHERE deleted = 0) AS inventory_sku_count, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM wms_inventory WHERE deleted = 0) AS inventory_total_amount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sku_id) FROM wms_inventory WHERE expire_date IS NOT NULL AND expire_date <= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND deleted = 0) AS expire_30_sku_count

SELECT DATE(create_time) AS d, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM
wms_stock_in wms_stock_out
WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY d ASC

SELECT i.sku_id, MAX(i.sku_code) AS sku_code, MAX(i.sku_name) AS sku_name, SUM(i.actual_qty) AS qty,
SUM(i.subtotal) SUM(i.subtotal_sale)
AS amount FROM
wms_stock_in_item i wms_stock_out_item i
INNER JOIN
wms_stock_in o ON i.stock_in_id = o.stock_in_id wms_stock_out o ON i.stock_out_id = o.stock_out_id
AND o.deleted = 0 WHERE i.sku_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i.sku_id ORDER BY qty DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT i.warehouse_id, MAX(w.warehouse_name) AS warehouse_name, SUM(i.quantity) AS qty, SUM(i.total_amount) AS amount FROM wms_inventory i LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON i.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id AND w.deleted = 0 WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.warehouse_id

SELECT 'expire_30' AS type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM wms_inventory WHERE expire_date IS NOT NULL AND expire_date <= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'zero_stock' AS type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM wms_inventory WHERE quantity = 0 AND deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'negative_stock' AS type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM wms_inventory WHERE quantity < 0 AND deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'draft_over_3d' AS type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM wms_stock_in WHERE status = 0 AND create_time <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 3 DAY) AND deleted = 0

SELECT po.purchase_no, po.create_time AS purchase_time, s.supplier_name, w.warehouse_name, poi.line_no, poi.sku_code, poi.sku_name, poi.spec_text, poi.quantity AS order_qty, poi.delivered_qty, poi.unreceived_qty, poi.purchase_price, poi.subtotal FROM wms_purchase_order po LEFT JOIN wms_supplier s ON po.supplier_id = s.supplier_id AND s.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON po.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id AND w.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN wms_purchase_order_item poi ON po.purchase_id = poi.purchase_id WHERE po.deleted = 0
AND po.purchase_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.purchaseNo}, '%')
AND po.supplier_id = #{params.supplierId}
ORDER BY po.create_time DESC, poi.line_no ASC

SELECT w.warehouse_name, a.area_name, l.location_code, i.sku_code, i.sku_name, i.spec_text, u.unit_name, i.batch_no, i.quantity, i.locked_qty, i.available_qty, i.cost_price, i.total_amount, i.expire_date FROM wms_inventory i LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON i.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id AND w.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN wms_area a ON i.area_id = a.area_id AND a.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN wms_location l ON i.location_id = l.location_id AND l.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN wms_unit u ON i.unit_id = u.unit_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE i.deleted = 0
AND i.warehouse_id = #{params.warehouseId}
AND i.sku_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.skuCode}, '%')
ORDER BY w.warehouse_name, i.sku_code

SELECT w.warehouse_name, i.sku_code, i.sku_name, i.batch_no, i.produce_date, i.expire_date, i.quantity, i.cost_price, i.total_amount FROM wms_inventory i LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON i.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id AND w.deleted = 0 WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.batch_no IS NOT NULL
AND i.warehouse_id = #{params.warehouseId}
AND i.sku_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.skuCode}, '%')
ORDER BY i.expire_date ASC, i.sku_code ASC

SELECT w.warehouse_name, i.sku_code, i.sku_name, i.spec_text, i.batch_no, i.expire_date, DATEDIFF(i.expire_date, NOW()) AS remain_days, i.quantity, i.cost_price, i.total_amount FROM wms_inventory i LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON i.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id AND w.deleted = 0 WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.expire_date IS NOT NULL
AND DATEDIFF(i.expire_date, NOW()) <= #{params.days}
AND DATEDIFF(i.expire_date, NOW()) <= 30
ORDER BY remain_days ASC, i.sku_code ASC
